comparison.objective: Use carriage travel to self-align a floating guide rod, clamp it at the far end, then prove full return travel; candidate adjusts damping for acceptable stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Crank operation, position-dependent cam-clamp closure and travel verification versus hex-key loosening, collar tuning, setscrew locking and repeated impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Rod within 0.12° parallel and carriage reaches both stops without binding; candidate requires non-bottoming, low-rebound stops with retained setting. Candidate rebound/overload/drift thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both lock an adjustment and cycle a mechanism, but it tests carriage-induced geometric self-alignment and binding, not energy absorption or damping selection.
